name: Ghee, cow

platforms: Amul ghee MRP after GST cut

storage: Room temperature in an airtight jar, away from heat and light; always use a dry spoon (moisture spoils it). Fridge extends life to 6+ months.
looksLike: golden-yellow clarified butter, grainy and semi-solid at room temperature, clear liquid when warm, with a nutty, buttery smell.
howToPick: golden to pale-yellow colour, grainy texture when set, pleasant nutty smell. Avoid a rancid or soapy smell, a separated oily layer with off colour, or a bulged/damaged pack.
shelfLife: 9–12 months unopened (check pack); about 3 months after opening at room temperature if kept dry.
substitutes: Homemade ghee from butter or malai

usedIn.raw: 10 g (2 tsp: 1 for the masala, 1 for the tadka).
